# Crazy Comfort

> Woman-owned HVAC company in Katy, Texas. Comfort This Good is Crazy!

Crazy Comfort is a woman-owned heating and air conditioning company based in Katy, TX. Visits are documented with photos. The company does not advertise same-day or after-hours emergency service.

## Contact

- Phone: 832-403-7466
- Email: ez@crazycomfort.com
- License: TACLA00048090C
- Weekday office hours: Monday through Friday, 8am to 4pm. Call for current availability.
- Website: https://crazycomfort.com/

## Services

- AC repair ($129 diagnostic, credited toward the repair if the work is approved): https://crazycomfort.com/services/ac-repair/
- Heating repair: https://crazycomfort.com/services/heating-repair/
- System replacement: https://crazycomfort.com/services/system-replacement/
- Ductwork: https://crazycomfort.com/services/ductwork/
- Indoor air quality: https://crazycomfort.com/services/indoor-air-quality/
- HVAC maintenance plan ($189 per year or $17.99 per month): https://crazycomfort.com/hvac-maintenance-plan/
- $49 heating check through November 30, 2026: https://crazycomfort.com/heating-check/
- $50 off the first AC repair or tune-up, requested through the on-site form: https://crazycomfort.com/
